accept_only_if: A proof of full mathematical residual infinity nonincrease: affected exact max nonincreasing OR a current exact anchor outside the complete changed-column nonzero support with absolute residual >= affected exact after maximum.

deterministic_policy.mathematical_nonincrease_proof: Outside the complete changed-column nonzero support every exact equation is unchanged. Either the affected maximum does not increase, or its new maximum is bounded by the absolute residual of a certified unchanged row. In both cases the new global exact infinity norm cannot exceed its previous value.
deterministic_policy.termination: first accepted sequential state passing all five; otherwise at most 96 completed full candidates or exhaustion of current target finite adjacent-ULP candidates; unchanged resource and finite scalar/exact/cache caps stop as partial evidence
deterministic_policy.anchor_order: Seed original free DOF 59009 is directly summed from original K and starting full field. After gathering each candidate affected-before values, use seed if it lies outside the complete affected set and bounds affected-after maximum; otherwise choose the cached unaffected row of largest exact absolute current residual, first original DOF on ties. Cache entries are only directly summed original equations or exact accepted-column updates; the independent reader reconstructs the same known row pool and directly sums the chosen anchor before and after every trial.

finite_search_and_cache.cache_invalidation: accepted delta updates every cached affected row; all other exact equations unchanged; rejected delta never updates cache
